subject: SAME AS clause
notes: kb/Work PB889 LANDED. The rule names THREE clauses - 'A group item to which the subject of the entry is subordinate shall not contain a GROUP-USAGE, SIGN, or USAGE clause' - and ExpandSameAs's ancestor walk tested two (OwnUsage, OwnSign), so `01 OUTER GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL. 02 INNER SAME AS SRC2.` over SRC2 PIC N(4) compiled clean although COBOL1555's own text named GROUP-USAGE. Both SR walks now read ONE predicate, DataBinder.SuperordinateWithRepresentationClause (GroupUsage / OwnSign / OwnUsage), and the diagnostic names the offending superordinate. (Over a PIC X source the 13.18.60.3 SR12 rule, COBOL0881, rejects first and masks this answer - the negative uses PIC N(4) for that reason.) The legal side - a SAME AS entry under a group with none of the three clauses - is pinned by the 2002 positive. MEASURED at 2002 and 2014 on the worktree's own build: COBOL1555 '... shall not contain a GROUP-USAGE, SIGN, or USAGE clause - 'OUTER' does (ISO 13.18.49.3 SR9)'. EDITIONS 2002/2014/2023 (SAME AS is a 2002 introduction; its own 0900 gate covers 85).
